attr.text:
Highly advised to look 
at linked video in notes

The boss moves here
so to keep uptime you split into
melee range

Where your clone spawns will determine
which role you are in the mechanic and 
your light party.

LP1- NW CCW

LP2- N CW

After snaking kick, boss will cast Reenactment
and all player clones will begin executing the tether mechanic
you picked up earlier in order of the clone appearance.

Split into Melee & Range groups and begin making your way to the clones E/W 
to soak the stack (needs at least one person in it or it blows up)

Wait for the 2nd clones 
to go off before moving

Cleaves go between party and boss to not cleave
anyone and keep uptime during 2 minutes

Depending on which PLAYER clone you were
assigned, you will pick up the right tether utilizing
snake prio based on your acting LP from Slide 3

Just run to your add to
pick up the tether

Highly advised
to look at linked video example

The boss begins by spawning 8 player clones
in order North and South going 1->4 always in this order.

After all clones have been spawned,
the boss will spawn 6 clones of HIMSELF. 

The clones and the boss will begin 
tethering players with a
mechanic. These tethers can be picked up.

Mechs:
2 tether Stack indicators
2 tether Spread (Defamation) indicators
2 tether Cleave indicators
Boss tether - > Jumps on players and point blank aoe
No tether gets an untelegraphed defamation

Once tethers lock in,
everyone should start moving to
their positions for the mechanic.

Boss will begin casting Firefall splash.
Once this cast finishes the boss clones
will begin executing their mechanics on the players

Boss will jump to the player who picked up
the boss tether and execute a point blank aoe +
4 thin cleaves on other nearest players.

Defams will go off on defam tethers
and the player who didnt pick up a tether

Afterwards Light Party stacks go off on players who
picked up stack tethers.
Defamations can jump back in to share the stacks. 
Based on slide 3 go to your light party 
(this doesnt do too much damage) 
so its ok if you have a 5/3 split.

The boss will immediately start casting Snaking Kick
on a random player, DODGE BEHIND HIM

Since Boss will always cleave towards
a light party, A marker is ALWAYS SAFE!

The boss will then begin 
casting Netherwrath Near/Far.
This is a partner stack baited on 
closest or furthest player.
Assign the Defam Players 
to bait these.

Once this cast finishes 
the 1st clones will execute 
their mechanic.

The north clone will repeat 
the point blank aoe from before 
with the thincleaves targetted on 
the SAME players from before. 
Use the same lineup.
<- Defam Bait spot is safe here too
<- Defam Bait spot is safe here too

For recovery purposes, these stacks are easily liveable
with 3 or even 2 with mitigations.
